name: lamp-design-system
description: LAMP Design System — tokens, primitives and LAMP object components for the enterprise AI operating environment.

scripts.check: node tools/build-bundle.mjs && node tools/check-system.mjs && npm run check:types
scripts.test: npm run check && node tools/verify-browser.mjs && node tools/verify-package.mjs
scripts.check:types: node tools/build-package.mjs && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/vite-app/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:example: npm run build:pkg && vite build examples/vite-app
